title: Registered Nurse
summary: We are seeking a skilled and compassionate Registered Nurse to join our healthcare team.
responsibilities: Provide patient care, Monitor vital signs, Administer medications, Maintain medical records
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Nursing, Valid RN license, 2+ years clinical experience
competencies: Patient care, Communication, Problem-solving, Attention to detail, Teamwork

title: ICU Nurse
summary: MeQrez General Hospital in partnership with Ethio Health Care is looking for dedicated and compassionate nurses to join our team.
responsibilities:
- Provide quality patient care and support
- Monitor patient health conditions
- Administer medications as prescribed
- Maintain detailed patient records
- Collaborate with healthcare team members
qualifications:
- ICU Nurse certification
- Minimum 1 year of relevant work experience
- Strong communication and patient care skills
- Professional demeanor and ethical practice
competencies: Patient Care, Medical Knowledge, Communication, Teamwork, Problem-solving, Attention to Detail, Compassion
